[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new Japanese recipes to try, specifically something other than sushi and ramen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Japanese dishes include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Tonkatsu: A breaded and deep-fried pork cutlet served with shredded cabbage, rice, and miso soup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Yakitori: Grilled chicken skewers flavored with salt or teriyaki sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Udon: Thick wheat flour noodles served hot or cold with broth, vegetables, and protein.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Teriyaki Chicken or Salmon: Grilled meat glazed with teriyaki sauce, served with rice and vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Gyoza: Pan-fried dumplings filled with ground pork and vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Bento: A Japanese-style lunchbox with a balance of carbs, protein, and vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Oyako Donburi: Rice bowl topped with chicken, egg, and onions in a soy sauce-based broth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Hiyayakko: Cold tofu dish served with ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Karaage: Japanese-style fried chicken marinated in soy sauce and deep-fried.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Miso Katsu Curry: Breaded pork or chicken cutlet served with miso-based curry sauce and rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Tofu Tempura: Crispy fried tofu served with rice and dipping sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Onigiri: Triangular rice balls filled with tuna, salmon, or pickled plum.  
[PREFERENCE] User is intrigued by Tonkatsu and seeks recommendations for the type of pork cutlet to use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cut for Tonkatsu is the Loin Cutlet, also known as Pork Loin Fillet or Pork Tenderloin.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Characteristics to look for in pork loin cutlet:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Thickness: About 1-1.5 inches (2.5-3.8 cm).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Marbling: Moderate fat distribution for flavor and tenderness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Tenderness: Firm but not hard, avoiding excessive fat or
